events.title: EY 与 CrowdStrike 达成全球联盟：在 Falcon 平台上构建 AI 安全能力，覆盖 20+ 成员所
events.title_en: EY and CrowdStrike form global alliance to build AI security capabilities on the Falcon platform across 20+ member firms
events.summary: EY 于 11 月初宣布与 CrowdStrike 建立全球联盟：基于 Falcon 平台构建 AI 驱动的安全能力，覆盖 EY 20+ 成员所，并计划在未来一年内完成相关人才培训。将 AI 与网络安全深度绑定，是治理/风险维度与科技合作维度的双重信号。
events.summary_en: EY announced a global alliance with CrowdStrike in early November: AI-powered security capabilities built on the Falcon platform across 20+ EY member firms, with workforce training planned over the next year.

events.title: EY 举办 AI Week：一周专题活动聚焦企业 AI 下一波浪潮
events.title_en: EY runs AI Week: a week-long program on the next wave of AI for business
events.summary: EY 于 11-02 至 11-06 举办 AI Week 专题活动，邀请趋势研究者与 EY 领导层讲解企业 AI 下一波浪潮。属品牌与思想领导力活动，与德勤 AI Forum 同类。
events.summary_en: EY ran AI Week (November 2–6) featuring trendwatchers and EY leaders on the next wave of AI for business — a brand and thought-leadership program comparable to Deloitte's AI Forum.

events.title: EY 发布客户服务 AI 报告：头部组织核心客服 KPI 提升超 50%
events.title_en: EY releases customer service AI report: top performers see over 50% improvement in core service KPIs
events.summary: EY 于 2026-11-03 发布客户服务 AI 研究：表现最好的组织在核心客服 KPI 上实现超过 50% 的改善，为 AI 在运营场景的价值兑现提供了量化证据。
events.summary_en: On November 3, 2026, EY released research finding AI delivered over 50% improvements across core customer service KPIs for top-performing organizations.

events.title: KPMG 在 30 个国家测试私企审计 AI 工具：首个同类规模化部署
events.title_en: KPMG tests advanced AI tools for private-company audits across 30 countries — a first-of-its-kind rollout
events.summary: KPMG 于 2026-11-05 披露在 30 个国家测试面向私营企业审计的高级 AI 工具，为同类首次规模化推广；审计是四大核心业务中标准化程度最高、AI 替代潜力最大的场景之一。
events.summary_en: On November 5, 2026, KPMG disclosed it is testing advanced AI tools for audits of private companies across 30 countries — a first-of-its-kind rollout.

events.title: Capgemini 发布金融服务多代理 AI 研究：机构加速转向多代理体系以追求底线价值
events.title_en: Capgemini releases multi-agent AI research for financial services: institutions accelerating shift for bottom-line value
events.summary: Capgemini 于 2026-11-04 发布金融服务多代理 AI 研究：金融机构正加速转向多代理 AI 体系，以追求底线价值；延续其 10 月财报后「AI 需求 → 收入」的叙事。
events.summary_en: On November 4, 2026, Capgemini released research on multi-agent AI in financial services: institutions are accelerating the transition to multi-agent systems in a drive for bottom-line value.

events.title: BCG X AI Science Institute 与 Nature 设立 AI for Discovery Awards 并公布首批获奖者
events.title_en: BCG X AI Science Institute and Nature announce first AI for Discovery Awards winners
events.summary: BCG X 的 AI Science Institute 与 Nature 于 2026-11-06（波士顿/伦敦）公布首届 AI for Discovery Awards 得主：四位研究者分别在健康、可持续与制造领域用 AI 推动科学发现。学术出版巨头 + 咨询 AI 研究所的组合，是 BCG X 科研路线的独特信号。
events.summary_en: On November 6, 2026 (Boston/London), BCG X's AI Science Institute and Nature announced the first AI for Discovery Awards — four researchers applying AI across health, sustainability, and manufacturing.

events.title: Bain 发布《What's Still Missing from Your AI Strategy? Proprietary Intelligence》：差异化来自专有智能
events.title_en: Bain publishes 'What's Still Missing from Your AI Strategy? Proprietary Intelligence'
events.summary: Bain 于 11 月发布新报告，主张企业 AI 战略的差异化来自专有数据与专有智能（proprietary intelligence）的构建，而非通用模型调用；补上 Bain 近三周的 quiet 期。日期精度为月份。
events.summary_en: In November, Bain published a new report arguing differentiated AI strategy comes from building proprietary data and intelligence rather than calling general models — ending Bain's quiet stretch.
